prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer
- If you want the lowest installed price and a solid warranty: Costco Tire Center (Pleasanton Costco).
- If you want the widest selection, fast appointments and flexible hours: Discount Tire (serves Pleasanton area).
- If you want full-service (alignment, repairs, dealer-level service) or personalized attention: a well‑rated independent shop in Pleasanton or your dealer.

What to consider when choosing where to buy/install tires
- Total installed price (tires + mounting/balancing + valve stems + disposal + tax). Ask for a complete written estimate.
- Appointment availability and typical wait time.
- What’s included: free rotations, lifetime balancing, TPMS reprogramming, road‑hazard warranty.
- Alignment: most shops charge extra — get an alignment if tires are uneven or you’re switching sizes.
- Reputation: prefer shops with many recent 4–5 star reviews and clear warranty policies.
- Equipment/tech: computerized balancers, TPMS tools, trained techs.

Why the three picks above
- Costco Tire Center: typically very competitive installed prices and good road‑hazard/warranty handling for members. They do get busy and require appointments.
- Discount Tire: large inventory, good price matching, quick installs and good customer service for repairs/rotations.
- Independent shops/dealer: better if you want a one‑stop shop for alignment, suspension diagnosis, and OEM advice — and for attentive, local service.

Next step I can help with
- If you tell me your vehicle (make/model/year), tire size or budget, and whether you’re a Costco member, I’ll recommend the best tire models and suggest which local shop type to use.
- If you want, give me your ZIP or a cross‑street in Pleasanton and I’ll list specific nearby shops to call (note: I can’t fetch live data, so you should verify hours/availability).
